reason: The drawer check and seeing who is in which chair are useful, but I already count the cash myself every night and my register works. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month forever is one more fixed cost, and in slow months I will be paying it whether the chairs are full or not.
objection: A monthly fee that never stops. Once my staff and customer data are inside your app I cannot easily leave, and the price can go up any time.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: a one-time price, or one year paid upfront at a real discount with the setup fee waived, and my customer data exportable if I stop.
